import os
import sys
import tempfile
from pathlib import Path

from gov.config.loader import load_config

with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:
    try:
        print(load_config(Path(tmp)))
    except Exception as exc:
        print("load_config failed:", type(exc).__name__, exc)
print(sys.version)
print(os.environ.get("TMPDIR"))
